FN-D7WXHN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 44
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 44 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund for
reasonable costs incurred for the consultation and preparation of a petition in any commitment
proceeding, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of petitions consulted on
and prepared for a petitioner by an attorney prior to official appointment and approval by the
probate judge.
Page 1

FN-D7WXHN-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 44
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/27/2023
Senate Bill 44 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of attorney fees paid in relation to certain
petitions consulted on and prepared for a petitioner by an attorney prior to official appointment,
as approved by the probate judge.
